coverage.adversarial_review: Generic Transformers Qwen2 attention does not implement custom DCA. Reported speedups measure complete systems and TP/hardware conditions, not an isolated sparse-attention primitive. Long-context extension has mixed short-task changes; retrieval success does not prove million-token synthesis reliability.
